newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Singleton plans A$1.80 special div.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Singleton plans A$1.80 special div.

text.p: Advertising agency Singleton Group Ltd said on Monday it planned a special fully franked dividend payment of about A$1.80 per share following the sale of its 10 percent voting stake in the television network Ten Group Ltd.
The stake in Ten, Australia's third ranked network, was announced on November 11 for A$59.15 million and went to a company associated with investor Isi Leibler and CanWest Global Communications Corp.
Canwest has a 15 percent voting stake in Ten, the maximum allowed for a foreign company, and an economic interest of more than 60 percent which is now under scrutiny by the industry regulator.
Singleton said the special dividend was expected to be paid in July next year.
It also said it would establish another advertising agency and was examining the possible takeover of a direct marketing company.
